title: iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB Cosmic Orange or Dark Blue $1,850 Delivered @ SkyTree Phones
body:
Deal: iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB Cosmic Orange or Dark Blue $1,850 Delivered @ SkyTree Phones

[sasangeleus] Hey my dude, you might want to do some edits to your header otherwise you are going to get roasted
[A female dog] Dunno how people are managing to price beat sky tree. Every single OW I’ve called in my locality have refused to price beat this mob
[frugirlninja] I went in store. I think that appears to work best. Best wishes to all. Just sharing my experience. Im not an expert poster. More people have voted for me to edit post instead of voting for the post. Not looking for likes here, just supporting like minded bargain hunters.
[Nillionaire] Thanks for sharing! The post is fine now :)
[Lingnoi] Some people post their receipts to avoid being called a liar ;)
[intrigued101] Could you please share the invoice if possible (I trust you completely), I will go into a store tomorrow and it might help me. Sorry for the trouble.
[OzBed] Use the 10%off ultimate gift card and it’ll be $1581 wow
[cpapi] Then you spend $1581 on gift cards, and none of them price match, then what lol
[OzBed] Obviously get price match approved before spend $$ on gift cards
[SamVicious] Correct me if I'm wrong, but when you manage to price match via phone call or online chat, they send you a link to the price matched product. Then, you can buy the gift card and use it to purchase. I might be wrong as I've never price matched with OW before, just JB hi-fi.
[dlakers3peat] @nightelves: No they don't. As soon as they agree to the price match OW takes payment immediately over the phone via credit using your telephones keypad to enter the cc number.
[KiwiBloke] Pretty sure officeworks doesnt send a link, but you just purchase over the phone by giving the customer rep your card details.
Also you can only use 1 ultimate gift card online at officeworks (can use multiple instore though)
[backupper1] and also cannot use number of gc at OW like you do at JB
[MrFrugalSpend] officeworks - but only in $50 denominations, but see my comment below about technology category…
[MrFrugalSpend] For the Ultimate gift cards, officeworks apparently doesn't work on the technology category… at least online
[OzBed] Yes the restrictions only apply to online order. But you can’t use multiple $50 ultimate gc online anyway. So go to a good store where they honor price match and use gift card normally is the best way.
[AustriaBargain] It's the latest iPhone, but next month when iPhone 18 is revealed it will be the old one.
[hiltonlee981] Nice find — in-store seems to be the way for OW price beat, a few people saying phone/local stores knocked it back. Did they ask for a SkyTree link/screenshot at the counter, or was the advertised price enough?
Also curious: was OnePass + Flybuys applied at till as one scan, or did you stack them somehow after?
[WwDesi] You show them the site if you find someone Lucky they will say Okie and price beat and you can scan your OnePass or Flybuys
[xenoic] New iPhone about to get announced in about a month's time but apparently the new model will get price hike due to RAM prices :(
[AkiraSaito] OMG, I just bought one from Costco today for $1889…
